t: In front of you on Portland Place is a statue of General Władysław Sikorski. It shows the Polish military and political leader, who lived from 1881 to 1943. The sculptor was Faith Winter, a British artist who made statues and memorials to military and historical figures for towns and cities across Britain. A figure like Sikorski, set in the middle of London, is a reminder of the Polish connection with this city. Take a look at the figure and the pedestal before you move on.
